name: gemini-ai-chatbot-monorepo
description: Monorepo root for Gemini AI Chatbot

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
